'''Samire Mandel''' was the daughter of [[Kvarn Mandel]], the head of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech, Inc]]. She disappeared at the age of sixteen and although there was no proof, by the time eleven years had passed, Mandel had convinced himself that his daughter was dead.
